responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s core TyTy type hierarchy and most type-semantic operations. This file defines the concrete internal representations for inference variables, ADTs, references, pointers, tuples, arrays, functions, params, placeholders, projections, dynamic trait objects, closures, and primitive types together with cloning, pretty-printing, equality/compatibility checks, substitution and monomorphization hooks, bound satisfaction and compatibility logic, autoderef-comparison mode support, and object-item enumeration for dyn traits.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for the TyTy classes declared in rust-tyty.h. Unlike the header, this .cc provides the executable semantics of the type hierarchy—such as string formatting, equality and compatibility checks, bound satisfaction, cloning, autoderef comparison mode, substitution handling, and dyn-object item enumeration.
